claims_supported: the registered Float32 sampled-sphere GridSDF body completes one WaterLily primal on the Kaggle T4 CUDA backend
the CUDA solver run returns finite fields and force history with positive drag and bounded stationarity
the sampled T4 drag is within the registered 1% bound of the existing CPU sampled-sphere fixture
claims_not_supported: no flow-grid convergence, absolute Cd validation, or literature validation
no gradient, reverse-mode, topology, v16 or optimizer qualification
no target-aerodynamics, full-vehicle or high-Re claim
registration_note: The minimal gridsdf job path was committed and locally syntax-parsed first; all numerical and resource gates below are fixed before the first Kaggle sampled-sphere CUDA measurement.

affine_map.provenance: registers the W1-measured map for the sphere fixture with D = 1.0 m over 16 solver units

canonical_phi.construction: exact float64 sphere SDF on the lattice, cast to Float32 exactly as genesis stores phi; built through the W1 gate constructor

flow.boundary_conditions: uBC = (U,0,0), no periodic direction, exitBC disabled

geometry.description: W1 GridSDFWaterLilyBody using the exact registered canonical Float32 sphere phi on Kaggle CUDA
geometry.device_copy: CPU GridSDF constructor and margin gate, then CuArray copy and exact device round-trip SHA check before constructing the WaterLily body

time.time_weighted_mean: diagnostic: trapezoidal integral of the window samples, integral(F dt)/integral(dt) using actual sim_time

backend.uuid_policy: Record the selected first inventory UUID and bind it to this run; do not compare ephemeral Kaggle UUIDs across versions.

gates_registered_before_measurement.T0_prerequisites: K0 and W1g round 2 result hashes match; T4 Project/Manifest match the registered W0b pair.
gates_registered_before_measurement.T1_completion: mode is gridsdf, steps > 0, and sim_time reaches at least 60 tU/D.
gates_registered_before_measurement.T2_finiteness: finite_u and finite_p are true at the end of the run.
gates_registered_before_measurement.T3_force_finite: every sampled force is finite, force_samples > 0, and the retrieved force CSV SHA matches the summary.
gates_registered_before_measurement.T5_stationarity: abs(first-half mean drag - second-half mean drag) / abs(window-mean drag) <= 0.02.
gates_registered_before_measurement.T6_cpu_kaggle_agreement: abs(Kaggle sampled drag - registered W2a CPU sampled drag) / abs(CPU sampled drag) <= 0.01.
gates_registered_before_measurement.T7_sampled_analytic_agreement: abs(Kaggle sampled Cd - registered W2-T4a analytic T4 Cd) / abs(analytic T4 Cd) <= 0.10.
gates_registered_before_measurement.T9_canonical_grid: phi SHA equals the registered CPU canonical phi SHA; device round-trip SHA is identical; margin is >= 0.15 m and within 1e-6 m of the registered 0.19999998807907104 m.
gates_registered_before_measurement.T10_runtime_vram: wall_seconds and ms_per_step are positive; 0 < peak_vram_bytes < vram_total_bytes.
gates_registered_before_measurement.T11_backend_identity: two Tesla T4s are listed; selected first UUID is recorded; driver, compute capability, CUDA runtime, Julia, CUDA.jl, WaterLily, Project and Manifest equal the registered values.
gates_registered_before_measurement.T12_artifact_retrieval: version-specific Kaggle output has a DONE marker and every file in its SHA-256 manifest verifies locally.

failure_policy: Any failed gate is a diagnostic stop; preserve outputs and do not relax a bound after observing the GPU result. Register a new round before any retry with changed criteria.
scope_exclusions: no W2b flow-grid convergence or 24/32 cells per diameter
no absolute or literature Cd validation
no gradient, reverse mode, topology, v16 or optimizer qualification
